description: One day's dispatch-readiness report, as produced by the sync agent's pending_readiness.py. Holds the browsable page verbatim plus the structured report behind it. INTERNAL: names parties, order numbers and shortfalls, so it is desk-only and must never be exposed to the portal.

fields.label: As At
fields.description: The report date. It is also the record name, so re-uploading a day replaces it rather than piling up duplicates.

fields.label: Generated On
fields.description: When the agent ran, which is not the same as when it was uploaded.

fields.label: Dispatchable %
fields.description: Share of measurable pending demand coverable from stock on hand.

fields.label: Payload
fields.description: Stored twice on purpose: the page is what the desk shows, and the structured report is what any later re-render or comparison reads. Neither is edited by hand.

fields.label: Page HTML
fields.description: The self-contained report page. Rendered inside a sandboxed frame on the Dispatch Readiness desk page, never injected into the desk itself.

name: Dispatch Readiness Snapshot
